provenance.paper_title: MemoryVLA++: Temporal Modeling via Memory and Imagination in Vision-Language-Action Models

representation_paths.memory_component: perceptual-cognitive history and imagined future latents

evidence.paraphrase: The bank retrieves historical tokens while a world model supplies future latents.

During operation, MemoryVLA++ applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to perceptual-cognitive history and imagined future latents; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

Redundancy-aware consolidation updates the bank. For MemoryVLA++, this specifically supports merging or deduplication of overlapping entries of perceptual-cognitive history and imagined future latents.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (perceptual-cognitive history and imagined future latents) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
